title: Team Member - Project Planning
jobDescription:

title: Team Member - NPQ
location: VVC - GPC, Vellivoyalchavadi, Tamil Nadu , India
jobDescription:
Role:

1. Performing Upstream activities (Recurrence prevention, DMU study etc ) for BEV.

2. Analysing, tracking and closing of issues in battery performance, BMS , Electric Motor, power electronics and charging systems in BEV.

3. Analysing, tracking and closing of post lunch (QRT) issues with respect to battery management systems, thermal management systems and battery performance for BEV.

Reporting and documentation

NPQ Team Member is responsible for before Launch - Creation of Recurrence Prevention tracker, doing DMU reviews, involving in Proto, Pilot & Production build and sign off, capturing issues in all the above and following up with CFT for resolution of issues.

After Launch – formation of QRT team and resolution of teething issues with support from CFT

Skills required:

BE with 2-8 years of experience or Diploma with 4-8 years of experience in Electrical & Electronics engineering.

· Good understanding and knowledge of electrical systems circuits and components.

· Knowledge of battery types, chemistries and characteristics.

· Familiarity with automotive systems including power trains and control systems

· Experience with testing and validation methodologies of BEV.

· Knowledge of reading drawings, dimensions and tolerances.

· Basic knowledge of 3D experience and its usage for viewing DMU (Digital Mock Up) of vehicle and vehicle systems.

· Basic knowledge on FMEA and PPAP.

· Knowledge on Problem Solving techniques and in-depth Root Cause Analysis.

· Excellent inter-personal skills and should be a team player.

Scope & Scale of activities:

· Involve in Benchmarking activities to improve the New Product Quality.

· Discussion with CFT members (Field Quality, Service, Manufacturing, etc.) to get existing failures, as part of recurrence prevention, for resolution before new model launch.

· Involve in DMU reviews and capture issues for resolution of issues from design stage itself.

· Audit and certify the vehicle, during different stages of build, capture concerns related to vehicle build and vehicle reliability.

· Categorize the concerns as Process, Parts & Design and discuss with concerned stakeholders for resolution.

· Involve in the New Technologies projects along with the relevant stakeholders.

· Aligning self towards TQBM Practices.

· Clearance of building the new vehicles based on conforming pre-requisites.

· Clearance of passing the vehicle for trials / customers based on conforming pre-requisites.

· Provide necessary inputs to meet the IATF and TQBM requirements.
